The Local Chapters and Communities Congress 2026 (LCCC 2026) is a virtual event where members of various OSM communities come together to share stories and learn from each other, and to support and grow our mapping communities. This year it will take place on 28 March 2026. More info: https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Foundation/Local_Chapters/Local_Chapters_Congress/2026

Maps shouldn’t be ruled by the patriarchy—so let’s take them back. From colonial borders to corporate-controlled GPS, #maps have always been tools of power. #OpenStreerMap is different: open, feminist, and built by the people. This #IWD2026, #women it's your streets, your stories, your map. Add what’s missing. Reclaim the map. Join OpenStreetMap. #IWD #WomensDay #Feminism
